sections.title: Solution
sections.html:
To generate all subsets of the given set, we can use the Breadth First Search (BFS) approach. We can start with an empty set, iterate through all numbers one-by-one, and add them to existing sets to create new subsets.

Let’s take the example-2 mentioned above to go through each step of our algorithm:

Given set: [1, 5, 3]

  1. Start with an empty set: [[]]
  2. Add the first number (1) to all the existing subsets to create new subsets: [[], [1]];
  3. Add the second number (5) to all the existing subsets: [[], [1], [5], [1,5]];
  4. Add the third number (3) to all the existing subsets: [[], [1], [5], [1,5], [3], [1,3], [5,3], [1,5,3]].

Here is the visual representation of the above steps:

Since the input set has distinct elements, the above steps will ensure that we will not have any duplicate subsets.

Here is what our algorithm will look like:

Output

code.python3:
def find_subsets(nums):
  subsets = []
  # start by adding the empty subset
  subsets.append([])
  for currentNumber in nums:
    # we will take all existing subsets and insert the current number in them to create new subsets
    n = len(subsets)
    for i in range(n):
      # create a new subset from the existing subset and insert the current element to it
      set = list(subsets[i])
      set.append(currentNumber)
      subsets.append(set)

  return subsets


def main():

  print("Here is the list of subsets: " + str(find_subsets([1, 3])))
  print("Here is the list of subsets: " + str(find_subsets([1, 5, 3])))


main()

sections.title: Time complexity
sections.html: Since, in each step, the number of subsets doubles as we add each element to all the existing subsets, the time complexity of the above algorithm is O(2N)O(2^N)O(2​N​​), where ‘N’ is the total number of elements in the input set. This also means that, in the end, we will have a total of O(2N)O(2^N)O(2​N​​) subsets.

sections.title: Space complexity
sections.html: All the additional space used by our algorithm is for the output list. Since we will have a total of O(2N)O(2^N)O(2​N​​) subsets, the space complexity of our algorithm is also O(2N)O(2^N)O(2​N​​).
